To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have identified 2-(4- (2-methoxy-phenyl)piperazine-1-yl)-(1-(naphthyl-1-yl-sulfonyl)-indol-3- yl)-ethanol (4-j) as a highly potent 5-HT6 antagonist.
a new class of extended N-arylsulfonamidyl indoles has been identified with moderate to high affinity for 5-HT(6) receptors and with a high potential to act as antagonists.
a series of extended N-arylsulfonated indoles were designed and identified to be a new class of potent 5-HT6 antagonists.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design, synthesis and biological evaluation of novel 5-HT6 antagonists based on a known pharmacological model.
the design, synthesis and evaluation of new extended derivatives of the 1-(1-arylsulphonyl-1H-indole-3-yl)methanols scaffold as 5-HT(6) receptor ligands.
the design, synthesis, and pharmacological characterization of a new class of N-arylsulfonate indole derivatives.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the novel extended N-arylsulfonylindoles, especially compound 4j, represent a novel class of potent 5-HT6R modulators.
the extended N-arylsulfonated indole derivatives represent a promising novel chemical series for the development of potent and selective 5-HT6 modulators.
compound 4j represents the most potent and selective compound of the series.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have identified a new scaffold for 5-HT receptor modulators, which is a new class for 5-HT modulators and could be a starting point to further optimisation.
we have designed and synthesized a new class of N-arylsulfonated indoles and have identified a novel 5-HT6 antagonist with a pIC50 value of 7.48.
the N-arysulfonylindole scaffold is an interesting template to be used in the design of novel and potentially selective 5-HT6 antagonists.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the extended N-arylsulfonylindole scaffold is a novel pharmacophore for the development of potent and selective 5-HT6 antagonists.
the extended indole-based N-arylsulfonamide scaffold represents a new class of potent and selective 5-HT6 antagonists.
the extended N-arylsulfonamides of the indole core are a novel class of compounds with high affinity and functional potency as 5-HT 6 receptor antagonists.
